answer_2.quote: Naturalness measures how natural the poisoned instance reads. As an automatic evaluation proxy, we use a RoBERTa-Large classifier trained on the Corpus of Linguistic Acceptability (COLA) to make judgement on the grammatical acceptability of the poisoned instances for each method.

answer_4.quote: We ask five human annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) to classify them into human-written instances and machine-edited instances.
answer_4.guideline: The task description is shown in Figure. We get their final decisions on each instance by voting.
